problem_statement: Build a brand-new Content Tags page from scratch at the /tags route of this Sneat Vuetify + Vue 3 admin template. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the catch-all 404 view. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (vertical nav + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Vuetify design system already used across the template (VCard, VCardText, VBtn, VChip, VRow/VCol, the text-h4/text-body typography and the primary colour tokens). The page is a per-item tag-assignment workspace: a deterministic in-memory list of content items, each row showing its currently assigned tags plus a set of click-driven tag buttons (data-tag="<itemId>:<tag>") that add or remove that tag on THAT row only. A live 'N of 6 items tagged' summary (data-tagged-count) recomputes as tags are assigned. A fill-able search box (data-search) filters the visible rows by title. CRITICAL: each row's assigned tags must PERSIST across a search filter — assigning a tag, typing in the search box and clearing it again must leave the assignment (and the tagged count) unchanged; the search only filters which rows are shown, it must never reset the tag state. The page must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport. The data-tag attribute value is exactly "<itemId>:<tag>" where itemId is i1..i6 in the item's display order (i1=Onboarding checklist, i2=Quarterly report, i3=Bug triage notes, i4=Roadmap draft, i5=Release announcement, i6=Security review) and tag is the lowercase tag name: urgent, review or featured (e.g. the Urgent button on the Quarterly report row is data-tag="i2:urgent").
required_content: A page title 'Content Tags' with a short introductory blurb, sitting inside the existing dashboard shell
A primary 'Save tags' action button in the page header
A 'Tagging progress' summary card containing a prominent live count that reads 'N of 6 items tagged' and starts at '0 of 6 items tagged'
A 'Search items' label plus a fill-able search input that filters the item rows by title

An 'Item library' heading over a list of six content items, each showing its title and category. The six items, in order with their category label, are: Onboarding checklist (People Ops), Quarterly report (Finance), Bug triage notes (Engineering), Roadmap draft (Product), Release announcement (Marketing), Security review (Security).
Per-row tag buttons labelled Urgent, Review and Featured that add/remove that tag on that specific item, with assigned tags shown as chips on the row
Clicking a row's tag button assigns that tag to that item and the 'N of 6 items tagged' count recomputes live
Each item's assigned tags persist across a search filter: after searching and clearing, the assignment and the count are unchanged (the search only filters visible rows, never resets tag state)
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (vertical nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages, and the shared sidebar nav renders identically on a sibling existing page
design_constraints: Reuse Vuetify components already used by the template (VCard, VCardText, VBtn, VChip, VRow/VCol, VIcon)
Keep the template's colour palette, spacing and typography (text-h4/text-h6/text-body, primary colour); do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing default layout (vertical nav + navbar + footer) via a new route in src/plugins/router/routes.js
Tag buttons must be click-driven <button>s carrying data-tag attributes, not a native <select>; the search box must be a fill-able <input> carrying data-search

Use the template's existing palette tokens: primary #696CFF (rgb(105,108,255)); primary body/heading text rgba(34,48,62,0.9); page/card background #FFFFFF; and Vuetify semantic colours for the tag chips/buttons — warning #FFAB00 (Urgent), success #71DD37 (Featured), error #FF3E1D (Review). Do not introduce new brand colours.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /tags 挂顶层空页 (src/pages/tags.vue = <div/>, 注册为 layout 外顶层 route) → 渲染空白, 不走 catch-all [...error].vue。reference 完整实现 per-item tagging: assigned=ref({}) itemId->tags[]; toggleTag 只改该行; search=ref('') 仅过滤 visibleItems computed, 不动 assigned; 'N of 6 items tagged' data-tagged-count 实时重算。STATE-LINKED 持久化判别: bad 把 onSearch 改成每次 setAssigned({}) → 打完 tag 一搜索就清空 → 仅 desktop_tags_persist interaction 失败 (desktop_tags_tagged 仍过, 因为它不搜索)。regression: 复用 vertical nav <a> (Analytics/Account Settings) 断言在 desktop_tags 与 sibling desktop_typography 双页 + regression gate on desktop_typography。该 repo NON-file-based routing (手写 routes.js); app 在 javascript-version/ 子目录, project_root 强制指向 javascript-version (删 typescript-version + 改 .productwebbench_workspace.json)。node_modules 复用 slot_531 reference 已 build 好的 (含 iconify icons.css)。route 无 basename, state path=/tags。port 4660-4679。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。
